name: Lower Back Extensions

instructions.description: Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended overhead.
Engage your core muscles and slowly lift your chest and legs off the ground.
Hold the lifted position for a few seconds, then lower back down.
Ensure a smooth and controlled movement throughout the exercise.
Avoid straining your lower back by not overextending during the lift.
Consult with a fitness professional if you have any existing lower back issues.

commentsNotes: Maintain proper form to avoid strain on the lower back.
Start with a small range of motion and gradually increase as you build strength.
Listen to your body and stop if you feel any discomfort.
Engage your core muscles throughout the exercise for added support.
